component.name: PDFSigner
component.summary: Sign PDF documents with USB cryptographic tokens

developer.name: Homero Thompson del Lago del Terror

description.p: PDFSigner is a GTK4 application for digitally signing PDF documents using USB cryptographic tokens (PKCS#11). Features include:

ul.li: PAdES-LTV signatures with TSA timestamp
Support for multiple token types (SafeNet, YubiKey, Nitrokey, OpenSC)
Batch signing with PIN cache
Visible signature stamps with smart positioning
Signature validation
Dry-run mode for testing without real token
Color-coded banner showing certificate expiry status
Health levels: OK, WARNING, ALERT, CRITICAL, EXPIRED
Shows subject, issuer, expiry date, and progress bar
41 new tests, total now 393
Fixed settings validation to allow first-run without NSS database
NSS path existence now checked at runtime, not at settings load
Increased NSS setup wizard window height for better button visibility

description.p: Signature viewer and hybrid PDF fixes:

ul.li: Signature viewer in GUI with info button for full details
Fixed hybrid PDF validation (mixed xref tables/streams)
Word wrap in validation dialog for long text
TSA integration tests for DigiCert and Sectigo
17 new tests for file_list_widget and hybrid PDF
Fixed Debian package versioning in changelog
All packaging artifacts now show correct version
Updated AppStream metainfo with all release history
Fixed screenshot URLs for software centers
Improved release workflow

description.p: QR verification and code quality release:

ul.li: QR verification code in visible signatures (hash, signer, timestamp)
Refactored PKCS#11 library paths for better modularity
Updated packaging scripts with all dependencies
High quality stamp rendering (150 DPI)
Optional QR code in visible signatures
QR contains document hash, signer name, and timestamp
New --qr-code CLI flag
GUI checkbox in signature options
Flatpak with GNOME Platform 49
AppImage portable distribution
Debian package (.deb)
GitHub Actions release workflow
Auto-detection for 8+ token types
Improved TSA timestamp integration
Theme and language settings
